record.bible_text: These <FI>are<Fi> the statutes<WH02706> and judgments<WH04941>, which ye shall observe<WH08104><WTH8799> to do<WH06213><WTH8800> in the land<WH0776>, which the LORD<WH03068> God<WH0430> of thy fathers<WH01> giveth<WH05414><WTH8804> thee to possess<WH03423><WTH8800> it, all the days<WH03117> that ye live<WH02416> upon the earth<WH0127>.

Ye shall utterly<WH06><WTH8763> destroy<WH06><WTH8762> all the places<WH04725>, wherein the nations<WH01471> which<WH0834> ye shall possess<WH03423><WTH8802> served<WH05647><WTH8804> their gods<WH0430>, upon the high<WH07311><WTH8802> mountains<WH02022>, and upon the hills<WH01389>, and under every green<WH07488> tree<WH06086>: <RF>possess: or, inherit<Rf>

And ye shall overthrow<WH05422><WTH8765> their altars<WH04196>, and break<WH07665><WTH8765> their pillars<WH04676>, and burn<WH08313><WTH8799> their groves<WH0842> with fire<WH0784>; and ye shall hew down<WH01438><WTH8762> the graven images<WH06456> of their gods<WH0430>, and destroy<WH06><WTH8765> the names<WH08034> of them out of that place<WH04725>. <RF>overthrow: Heb. break down<Rf>
Ye shall not do so<WH06213><WTH8799> unto the LORD<WH03068> your God<WH0430>.<CM>

But unto the place<WH04725> which the LORD<WH03068> your God<WH0430> shall choose<WH0977><WTH8799> out of all your tribes<WH07626> to put<WH07760><WTH8800> his name<WH08034> there, <FI>even<Fi> unto his habitation<WH07933> shall ye seek<WH01875><WTH8799>, and thither thou shalt come<WH0935><WTH8804>:

And thither ye shall bring<WH0935><WTH8689> your burnt offerings<WH05930>, and your sacrifices<WH02077>, and your tithes<WH04643>, and heave offerings<WH08641> of your hand<WH03027>, and your vows<WH05088>, and your freewill offerings<WH05071>, and the firstlings<WH01062> of your herds<WH01241> and of your flocks<WH06629>:

And there ye shall eat<WH0398><WTH8804> before<WH06440> the LORD<WH03068> your God<WH0430>, and ye shall rejoice<WH08055><WTH8804> in all that ye put<WH04916> your hand<WH03027> unto, ye and your households<WH01004>, wherein the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> hath blessed<WH01288><WTH8765> thee.
Ye shall not do<WH06213><WTH8799> after all <FI>the things<Fi> that we do<WH06213><WTH8802> here this day<WH03117>, every man<WH0376> whatsoever <FI>is<Fi> right<WH03477> in his own eyes<WH05869>.
For ye are not as yet come<WH0935><WTH8804> to the rest<WH04496> and to the inheritance<WH05159>, which the LORD<WH03068> your God<WH0430> giveth<WH05414><WTH8802> you.

But <FI>when<Fi> ye go over<WH05674><WTH8804> Jordan<WH03383>, and dwell<WH03427><WTH8804> in the land<WH0776> which the LORD<WH03068> your God<WH0430> giveth you to inherit<WH05157><WTH8688>, and <FI>when<Fi>  he giveth you rest<WH05117><WTH8689> from all your enemies<WH0341><WTH8802> round about<WH05439>, so that ye dwell<WH03427><WTH8804> in safety<WH0983>;

Then there shall be a place<WH04725> which the LORD<WH03068> your God<WH0430> shall choose<WH0977><WTH8799> to cause his name<WH08034> to dwell<WH07931><WTH8763> there; thither shall ye bring<WH0935><WTH8686> all that I command<WH06680><WTH8764> you; your burnt offerings<WH05930>, and your sacrifices<WH02077>, your tithes<WH04643>, and the heave offering<WH08641> of your hand<WH03027>, and all your choice<WH04005> vows<WH05088> which ye vow<WH05087><WTH8799> unto the LORD<WH03068>: <RF>your choice...: Heb. the choice of your vows<Rf>

And ye shall rejoice<WH08055><WTH8804> before<WH06440> the LORD<WH03068> your God<WH0430>, ye, and your sons<WH01121>, and your daughters<WH01323>, and your menservants<WH05650>, and your maidservants<WH0519>, and the Levite<WH03881> that <FI> is<Fi> within your gates<WH08179>; forasmuch<WH03588> as he hath no part<WH02506> nor inheritance<WH05159> with you.
Take heed<WH08104><WTH8734> to thyself that thou offer<WH05927><WTH8686> not thy burnt offerings<WH05930> in every place<WH04725> that thou seest<WH07200><WTH8799>:

But in the place<WH04725> which the LORD<WH03068> shall choose<WH0977><WTH8799> in one<WH0259> of thy tribes<WH07626>, there thou shalt offer<WH05927><WTH8686> thy burnt offerings<WH05930>, and there thou shalt do<WH06213><WTH8799> all that I command<WH06680><WTH8764> thee.

Notwithstanding thou mayest kill<WH02076><WTH8799> and eat<WH0398><WTH8804> flesh<WH01320> in all thy gates<WH08179>, whatsoever thy soul<WH05315> lusteth after<WH0185>, according to the blessing<WH01293> of the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> which he hath given<WH05414><WTH8804> thee: the unclean<WH02931> and the clean<WH02889> may eat<WH0398><WTH8799> thereof, as of the roebuck<WH06643>, and as of the hart<WH0354>.
Only ye shall not eat<WH0398><WTH8799> the blood<WH01818>; ye shall pour<WH08210><WTH8799> it upon the earth<WH0776> as water<WH04325>.

Thou mayest<WH03201><WTH8799> not eat<WH0398><WTH8800> within thy gates<WH08179> the tithe<WH04643> of thy corn<WH01715>, or of thy wine<WH08492>, or of thy oil<WH03323>, or the firstlings<WH01062> of thy herds<WH01241> or of thy flock<WH06629>, nor any of thy vows<WH05088> which thou vowest<WH05087><WTH8799>, nor thy freewill offerings<WH05071>, or heave offering<WH08641> of thine hand<WH03027>:

But thou must eat<WH0398><WTH8799> them before<WH06440> the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> in the place<WH04725> which the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> shall choose<WH0977><WTH8799>, thou, and thy son<WH01121>, and thy daughter<WH01323>, and thy manservant<WH05650>, and thy maidservant<WH0519>, and the Levite<WH03881> that <FI>is<Fi> within thy gates<WH08179>: and thou shalt rejoice<WH08055><WTH8804> before<WH06440> the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> in all that thou puttest<WH04916> thine hands<WH03027> unto.
Take heed<WH08104><WTH8734> to thyself that thou forsake<WH05800><WTH8799> not the Levite<WH03881> as long as thou livest<WH03117> upon the earth<WH0127>. <RF>as long...: Heb. all thy days<Rf>

When the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> shall enlarge<WH07337><WTH8686> thy border<WH01366>, as he hath promised<WH01696><WTH8765> thee, and thou shalt say<WH0559><WTH8804>, I will eat<WH0398><WTH8799> flesh<WH01320>, because thy soul<WH05315> longeth<WH0183><WTH8762> to eat<WH0398><WTH8800> flesh<WH01320>; thou mayest eat<WH0398><WTH8799> flesh<WH01320>, whatsoever thy soul<WH05315> lusteth after<WH0185>.

If the place<WH04725> which the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> hath chosen<WH0977><WTH8799> to put<WH07760><WTH8800> his name<WH08034> there be too far<WH07368><WTH8799> from thee, then thou shalt kill<WH02076><WTH8804> of thy herd<WH01241> and of thy flock<WH06629>, which the LORD<WH03068> hath given<WH05414><WTH8804> thee, as I have commanded<WH06680><WTH8765> thee, and thou shalt eat<WH0398><WTH8804> in thy gates<WH08179> whatsoever thy soul<WH05315> lusteth after<WH0185>.

Even as the roebuck<WH06643> and the hart<WH0354> is eaten<WH0398><WTH8735>, so thou shalt eat<WH0398><WTH8799> them: the unclean<WH02931> and the clean<WH02889> shall eat<WH0398><WTH8799> <FI>of<Fi> them alike<WH03162>.

Only be sure<WH02388><WTH8798> that thou eat<WH0398><WTH8800> not the blood<WH01818>: for the blood<WH01818> <FI>is<Fi> the life<WH05315>; and thou mayest not eat<WH0398><WTH8799> the life<WH05315> with the flesh<WH01320>. <RF>be...: Heb. be strong<Rf>
Thou shalt not eat<WH0398><WTH8799> it; thou shalt pour<WH08210><WTH8799> it upon the earth<WH0776> as water<WH04325>.

Thou shalt not eat<WH0398><WTH8799> it; that it may go well<WH03190><WTH8799> with thee, and with thy children<WH01121> after<WH0310> thee, when thou shalt do<WH06213><WTH8799> <FI>that which is<Fi> right<WH03477> in the sight<WH05869> of the LORD<WH03068>.

Only thy holy things<WH06944> which thou hast, and thy vows<WH05088>, thou shalt take<WH05375><WTH8799>, and go<WH0935><WTH8804> unto the place<WH04725> which the LORD<WH03068> shall choose<WH0977><WTH8799>:

And thou shalt offer<WH06213><WTH8804> thy burnt offerings<WH05930>, the flesh<WH01320> and the blood<WH01818>, upon the altar<WH04196> of the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430>: and the blood<WH01818> of thy sacrifices<WH02077> shall be poured out<WH08210><WTH8735> upon the altar<WH04196> of the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430>, and thou shalt eat<WH0398><WTH8799> the flesh<WH01320>.

Observe<WH08104><WTH8798> and hear<WH08085><WTH8804> all these words<WH01697> which I command<WH06680><WTH8764> thee, that it may go well<WH03190><WTH8799> with thee, and with thy children<WH01121> after<WH0310> thee for<WH05704> ever<WH05769>, when thou doest<WH06213><WTH8799> <FI>that which is<Fi> good<WH02896> and right<WH03477> in the sight<WH05869> of the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430>.

When the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> shall cut off<WH03772><WTH8686> the nations<WH01471> from before<WH06440> thee, whither thou goest<WH0935><WTH8802> to possess<WH03423><WTH8800> them, and thou succeedest<WH03423><WTH8804> them, and dwellest<WH03427><WTH8804> in their land<WH0776>; <RF>succeedest...: Heb. inheritest, or, possessest them<Rf>

Take heed<WH08104><WTH8734> to thyself that thou be not snared<WH05367><WTH8735> by following<WH0310> them, after<WH0310> that they be destroyed<WH08045><WTH8736> from before<WH06440> thee; and that thou enquire<WH01875><WTH8799> not after their gods<WH0430>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, How did these nations<WH01471> serve<WH05647><WTH8799> their gods<WH0430>? even so will I do<WH06213><WTH8799> likewise<WH01571>. <RF>by...: Heb. after them<Rf>

Thou shalt not do<WH06213><WTH8799> so unto the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430>: for every abomination<WH08441> to the LORD<WH03068>, which he hateth<WH08130><WTH8804>, have they done<WH06213><WTH8804> unto their gods<WH0430>; for even their sons<WH01121> and their daughters<WH01323> they have burnt<WH08313><WTH8799> in the fire<WH0784> to their gods<WH0430>. <RF>to the: Heb. of the<Rf>

What thing<WH01697> soever I command<WH06680><WTH8764> you, observe<WH08104><WTH8799> to do<WH06213><WTH8800> it: thou shalt not add<WH03254><WTH8686> thereto, nor diminish<WH01639><WTH8799> from it.<CM>
